scale-unlimited/declaration-strict-value.message: Use a --text-*/--space-*/--radius-* token from src/styles/tokens.css instead of a raw value (see docs/design-system.md and docs/token-migration-checklist.md). If this is a genuine one-off, add it to ignoreValues in .stylelintrc.json and document the rationale in the PR (or in docs/design-system.md).
